name: grocery-assistant.v1
description: This dashboard displays products from six different stores, sorted by the best price per unit of measure. You can filter products using a search bar, as well as by units of measurement and product categories. Selected items appear in a shopping cart, where you can adjust quantities and easily compare prices across all stores to find the best value.

paragraphs: The data acquisition module is engineered for resilient and precise data extraction from dynamic API endpoints within the Wolt platform. It targets six prominent Romanian grocery retailers: Freshful, Profi, Penny, Auchan, Carrefour, and Kaufland.
features: Robust API Interaction: Employs sophisticated retry mechanisms with exponential backoff to effectively manage API rate limits and network transients. This ensures data integrity and reliability during collection.
